set.body:
Current scope: mandatory film/recall graph delivery under the unified-path epic, docs/ROADMAP.md and docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md. Supersedes old release-1.1 scheduling; the owner restored this commitment 2026-11-08 and approved the concrete continuation 2026-11-16.
Reuse F1-F6 -> additive compileFilm -> existing D1B film proofs/V1/E0, integrating the separately tracked event/context/relation construction slices. Preserve text compatibility, exact time/support, receipt authority and profile-specific P/F/remainder courts. The original movie-time proof children remain scoped obligations, not evidence of completion.
Closure: required construction, exchange and terminal artifacts execute with positive/refusal witnesses for each declared graph family, all applicable child proof obligations met or explicitly rescheduled with preserved scope, and a release/readiness record names experimental vs qualified uses. A categorical graph bundle cannot close probabilistic-profile courts. Scientific claim decisions live in the joint human study and are not graph construction gates.
set.title: [film] Current event-graph construction, exchange and terminal delivery
